comment: trap.c untrap() 6075-6081, 6090, 5944-5945 and 5887-5889. A debug Valkyrie, in a room against the map's west edge, wishes a trapped door onto the room's east doorway, steps back and repeats #untrap until she finds the trap; disarming it at XL1 fails, so the door explodes (6075-6081; not a shop, so 6082 does not run). She wishes a closed door into the empty doorway, quaffs a wished potion of confusion and repeats #untrap until the confused 1-in-3 roll 'finds' a trap: 'This door was not trapped.' (6090). She drops a wished large box, wishes a squeaky board under it, steps off and back on to reveal the board, and answers q to 'There is a container and a squeaky board here' (5944-5945). As a xorn (#polyself) she walks through the west wall to map column 1 and tries #untrap west: 'The perils lurking there are beyond your grasp.' (5887-5889).
